blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Generally fair weather is expected across the Visayas on Tuesday, Nov. 24, although localized rain showers and thunderstorms may develop, particularly in the afternoon and evening. In its daily weather forecast, Pagasa said the easterlies will bring partly cloudy to cloudy skies across the region, with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms. […]...
